ad_swipe.replication_plan: Prototype an original affirmation card with a press-and-hold progress state, glow transition, and reveal. Use distinct copy, visuals, colors, and interaction timing; compare it with an immediate tap reveal on activation and repeat-use metrics.
ad_swipe.why_it_works: The storefront describes a concrete tactile action—holding a button until the affirmation glows—so the benefit is demonstrated as an interaction rather than presented only as a claim.

playbook.claim: For faceless short-form videos, refresh the visual every three to five seconds and enable captions by default.
playbook.mechanism: Frequent visual changes reduce static-frame fatigue while captions preserve comprehension for sound-off viewers; test retention, completion, and shares against a slower-cut no-caption control.

playbook.claim: Test a hold-to-reveal affirmation interaction that makes the affirmation visibly glow before presenting the completed card.
playbook.mechanism: A brief press-and-hold creates a small embodied ritual and delayed reveal, potentially increasing attention and perceived participation; compare hold-to-reveal with an immediate tap reveal using completion rate, repeat sessions, and notification opens.
